pageProps.title: The Strange House
pageProps.review: We introduce the plot and honest reviews of the real estate mystery novel 'The Strange House', which deduces the strange sense of incongruity surrounding a mysterious space in an ordinary house floor plan.
pageProps.content:
## Review It is said that a video titled Real Estate Mystery - The Strange House released on a personal YouTube channel gained popularity and was released as a book.
It is a composition that deduces the strange sense of incongruity hidden in a seemingly ordinary house floor plan in a dialogue format.
In a seemingly ordinary house floor plan, there exists a ```mysterious space``` that is completely isolated without being connected to any door. This irrational structure felt a sense of incongruity, and the story begins when the narrator seeks advice from an acquaintance who is an architectural designer.
The way the story unfolded and the ideas were fresh. But that's about it. It started well, but it was nothing more than forced motives, processes, and a patched-up ending.
Maybe because I didn't know the video was the original, it was hard to read towards the end. It wasn't because the content was difficult, but I was worried if I should continue reading this forcedness.
Should something like this have been published? Such stories and developments definitely resonate more in videos.
